title: At U.N. Meeting, Syria’s Leader Is Strengthened, but Faces a Difficult Test
summary_full: President Ahmed al-Sharaa has improved his diplomatic standing since he last addressed the U.N. General Assembly but faces mounting domestic economic and security challenges.
